decisions.reason: An encrypted secondary channel builds directly on the firm's core cryptography and secure-communication knowledge, so it can interpret early feedback and refine the product in-house.
Mobile PDF signing extends the firm's existing digital signature competence and fits regulated demand such as eIDAS, so the related knowledge to improve it is already in place.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is the foundation for the firm's other security products, and it is where the firm's prior knowledge is deepest.

The email-to-app delivery robot relies on the firm's secure messaging know-how but is more peripheral and integration-heavy, so it carries moderate risk, though it is still worth keeping and learning from.

A hardware token takes the firm into less familiar hardware and logistics territory where its absorptive capacity is weaker, but it complements its signature know-how, so it is kept for now under scrutiny.
The payment-network compliance suite applies the firm's security expertise to steady regulatory demand, which allows assimilation and commercial use of compliance knowledge.
